summary: The Advanced row: per server, whether its tools are listed to clients that get the full tool list (auto) or only found through toolport_search_tools (search), the two interop switches and the longest a call may run, with the bridge ceiling that follows (server mode, servers_set_mode; the switches and the limit through server edit and servers_update_config). The mode and the switches apply at once with Undo, the limit has Save
